plugins.name: training-plan
plugins.description: Create a course for any learning goal, pitched at High school, Master's or Advanced level, Socratic by default. Lessons start with Try first, teach only what is missing and end with Show you've got it; the hardest ideas are taught through an aha moment and level by level, with fully worked examples. Lessons run on an interactive page, every step is saved in one course.json, and progress is computed across courses. Also includes a skill that writes PDF technical training manuals.
